title: fearless_simd v0.7: 64-bit integers, improved generics, SSE2, and upcoming v1.0
excerpt: fearless_simd v0.7: 64-bit integers, improved generics, SSE2, and upcoming v1.0
content_html:
Shnatsel, August 12, 2026

fearless_simd takes unsafe out of SIMD.

No matter what level of abstraction you're after, be it autovectorization and multiversioning, portable SIMD, or safe access to raw intrinsics and nothing more, fearless_simd has you covered!

It features zero dependencies, short build times, safe public APIs, and very little unsafe under the hood - orders of magnitude less than the alternatives!

The major additions in v0.7 are support for 64-bit integers, an explicit SSE2 level replacing scalar fallback on x86, improved support for generic programming, and more implemented SIMD operations.

This is also the last major release prior to Fearless SIMD v1.0, if no concerns about the API are raised.

64-bit integers

The entire API surface of fearless_simd is now also exposed for u64 and i64 vector types.

Earlier releases didn't support 64-bit integer vectors due to hardware support being spotty. For example, AVX2 lacks hardware support for many operations on 64-bit integers, so it would require emulating those operations using the available SIMD instructions to get decent performance.

Keeping track of which intrinsics are part of which instruction set was also challenging, and getting it wrong would be a memory safety violation. However, in v0.5 we made the compiler keep track of it for us, which removed the vast majority of unsafe blocks from fearless_simd and made implementing operations with uneven hardware support much easier.

All the other integer vector types (i8,u8,i16,u16,i32,u32) and f32/f64 were already supported by previous releases, so 64-bit integers were the last missing piece for full type coverage. We will investigate supporting f16 once the type is stabilized in the standard library.

More operations

  • swizzle_dyn is now implemented for all widths to allow arbitrary byte shuffles. I've also contributed performance improvements for this operation to std::simd. Unlike std::simd, Fearless SIMD supports both zeroing out-of-bounds indices and returning implementation-defined (but memory-safe) results for when you're sure all indices are in bounds, which is cheaper than zeroing on some platforms.
  • All types can now be widened/narrowed; e.g. you can convert vectors of u8 to u16, or u16 to u8 in SIMD code. You get to choose whether narrowing conversions wrap, like the as operator, or saturate, or do the cheapest thing the platform has to offer (useful if you're sure the values fit into the narrower type).
  • Added convenience functions shift_elements_left, shift_elements_right, rotate_elements_left, and rotate_elements_right for better compatibility with the std::simd API. They could already be implemented in terms of slide, but this makes the intent more clear.

Improved generic programming

Support for generic programming - writing functions that are generic over the vector type - has been substantially improved. Here are just a few highlights:

  • The SimdBase trait now abstracts over both integer and float vectors, and implements all methods available on both integers and floats.
  • Improvements to the Bytes trait allow generic bitcasts (safe transmutes) between SIMD vectors.
  • Every single operation on SIMD types is now available through a trait. There are no remaining operations implemented only for concrete types.
  • Associated types such as SimdBase::Element and SimdBase::Array now encode a lot of generic bounds to allow generic operations on them.

See the full changelog for details. All in all, generic SIMD programming is now much more pleasant, and allows expressing more algorithms generically.

These improvements also benefit users who abstract over SIMD vector types using macros, writing e.g. $type::from_slice instead of T::from_slice. They no longer need additional crates such as paste to inject types into function names, since all operations are now available on the types themselves.

Explicit SSE2 support

These days x86 systems without SSE4.2 are very rare. However, since SSE2 is part of the baseline instruction set in both x86_64 and i686 Rust targets, the presence of SSE2 can be assumed, without any runtime dispatch or multiversioning. Certain crates only need a very limited set of vector instructions and don't benefit from later extensions, so forgoing runtime dispatch can simplify the code and reduce binary size.

To better serve this use case, Fearless SIMD now has an explicit Sse2 level with operations expressed in terms of SIMD intrinsics, rather than relying on autovectorization of the Fallback level when SSE4.2 is not available. This improves performance on x86 when the user opts out of selecting the best SIMD implementation at runtime.

SSE2 remains a runtime-detected level on the tier-2 i586 targets, and can be disabled there using the usual multiversioning controls.

Build time improvements

Despite the addition of 64-bit integer vectors, more supported operations, and an entirely new SSE2 SIMD level, the compilation time of fearless_simd when used as a dependency stayed the same as v0.6: 2 seconds from scratch for x86 and 1 second from scratch for Aarch64. This was measured on my Zen 4 desktop CPU via cargo clean && cargo build --release --timings in an empty crate depending on fearless_simd.

Keeping compilation time unchanged despite the additions required a build profiling and optimization effort, without which the x86 build time would have increased to 3.4 seconds on my machine. It's still not that much for a from-scratch release build, and would have been entirely invisible for crates that have other dependency chains that take longer than 3.4 seconds to compile. But I believe that keeping build times low is important for Fearless SIMD to become a foundational SIMD abstraction. This is also a big part of why fearless_simd doesn't have any dependencies itself.

The vast majority of the fearless_simd API is made up of generic functions. They emit no machine code unless instantiated, so you don't pay for them in build time or binary size if you don't use them. The compiler only needs to type-check and borrow-check them, so the build time is almost entirely frontend-bottlenecked. On nightly Rust, using RUSTFLAGS=-Zthreads=8 to enable the parallel frontend halves the compilation time, so we have further improvements to look forward to once the parallel frontend is enabled in the stable toolchain.

API cleanups prior to 1.0

This release saw the type-specific reinterpret_* methods removed. These methods only existed for a handful of types, and each pair of types would need a separate method, which is impractical. So these were simply dropped in favor of the generic bitcast method. The load_interleaved_128 operation was renamed to load_four_interleaved, to make the intent more clear.

These are fairly minor API cleanups, and the API has been stable for nearly a year. Barring the recent changes to generics, the API has been proven in real-world projects, with over a dozen direct dependents on crates.io, and over a thousand github repositories using it directly or indirectly.

We are confident in the design of the crate, and it's time to make it official. If no concerns about the API are raised, we are going to ship v1.0 of Fearless SIMD in early September.

There are no breaking changes planned for v1.0. We could publish it today, but we chose to postpone it to allow some time for feedback from the community before finalizing the API.

We want to hear from you!

We believe fearless_simd can become the foundational SIMD crate for the Rust ecosystem, whether you want automatic vectorization, portable SIMD, safe access to intrinsics, or all of the above. This goal is now within sight.

Now more than ever, we'd like to hear from you! Are any APIs awkward or missing? Or is everything working smoothly? Please let us know either way!

You can either open an issue on the Github repository, or talk to us on Zulip.

sentences.en: To better serve this use case, Fearless SIMD now has an explicit Sse2 level with operations expressed in terms of SIMD intrinsics, rather than relying on autovectorization of the Fallback level when SSE4.2 is not available.
sentences.zh: 为了更好地服务此用例，Fearless SIMD 现在具有显式 Sse2 级别，其操作以 SIMD 内在函数表示，而不是在 SSE4.2 不可用时依赖回退级别的自动向量化。

sentences.en: This improves performance on x86 when the user opts out of selecting the best SIMD implementation at runtime.
sentences.zh: 当用户选择在运行时不选择最佳 SIMD 实现时，这可以提高 x86 上的性能。

blocks.html_en: SSE2 remains a runtime-detected level on the tier-2 i586 targets, and can be disabled there using the usual multiversioning controls.

sentences.en: SSE2 remains a runtime-detected level on the tier-2 i586 targets, and can be disabled there using the usual multiversioning controls.
sentences.zh: SSE2 在第 2 层 i586 目标上仍然是运行时检测级别，并且可以使用常用的多版本控制来禁用。

blocks.html_en: Build time improvements

sentences.en: Build time improvements
sentences.zh: 构建时间改进

blocks.html_en: Despite the addition of 64-bit integer vectors, more supported operations, and an entirely new SSE2 SIMD level, the compilation time of fearless_simd when used as a dependency stayed the same as v0.6: 2 seconds from scratch for x86 and 1 second from scratch for Aarch64. This was measured on my Zen 4 desktop CPU via cargo clean && cargo build --release --timings in an empty crate depending on fearless_simd.

sentences.en: Despite the addition of 64-bit integer vectors, more supported operations, and an entirely new SSE2 SIMD level, the compilation time of fearless_simd when used as a dependency stayed the same as v0.6: 2 seconds from scratch for x86 and 1 second from scratch for Aarch64.
sentences.zh: 尽管添加了 64 位整数向量、更多支持的操作以及全新的 SSE2 SIMD 级别，但用作依赖项时，fearless_simd 的编译时间仍与 v0.6 相同：x86 从头开始​​ 2 秒，Aarch64 从头开始​​ 1 秒。

sentences.en: This was measured on my Zen 4 desktop CPU via cargo clean && cargo build --release --timings in an empty crate depending on fearless_simd.
sentences.zh: 这是在我的 Zen 4 桌面 CPU 上通过 Cargo Clean && Cargo build --release --timings 在空箱中根据 fearless_simd 进行测量的。

blocks.html_en: Keeping compilation time unchanged despite the additions required a build profiling and optimization effort, without which the x86 build time would have increased to 3.4 seconds on my machine. It's still not that much for a from-scratch release build, and would have been entirely invisible for crates that have other dependency chains that take longer than 3.4 seconds to compile. But I believe that keeping build times low is important for Fearless SIMD to become a foundational SIMD abstraction. This is also a big part of why fearless_simd doesn't have any dependencies itself.

sentences.en: Keeping compilation time unchanged despite the additions required a build profiling and optimization effort, without which the x86 build time would have increased to 3.4 seconds on my machine.
sentences.zh: 尽管添加了一些内容，但要保持编译时间不变，需要进行构建分析和优化工作，否则，我的计算机上的 x86 构建时间将增加到 3.4 秒。

sentences.en: It's still not that much for a from-scratch release build, and would have been entirely invisible for crates that have other dependency chains that take longer than 3.4 seconds to compile.
sentences.zh: 对于从头开始的版本构建来说，这仍然不是那么多，并且对于具有其他依赖链（编译时间超过 3.4 秒）的包来说，它是完全不可见的。

sentences.en: But I believe that keeping build times low is important for Fearless SIMD to become a foundational SIMD abstraction.
sentences.zh: 但我相信，保持较短的构建时间对于 Fearless SIMD 成为基础 SIMD 抽象非常重要。

sentences.en: This is also a big part of why fearless_simd doesn't have any dependencies itself.
sentences.zh: 这也是fearless_simd 本身没有任何依赖项的一个重要原因。

blocks.html_en: The vast majority of the fearless_simd API is made up of generic functions. They emit no machine code unless instantiated, so you don't pay for them in build time or binary size if you don't use them. The compiler only needs to type-check and borrow-check them, so the build time is almost entirely frontend-bottlenecked. On nightly Rust, using RUSTFLAGS=-Zthreads=8 to enable the parallel frontend halves the compilation time, so we have further improvements to look forward to once the parallel frontend is enabled in the stable toolchain.

sentences.en: The vast majority of the fearless_simd API is made up of generic functions.
sentences.zh: fearless_simd API 的绝大多数都是由通用函数组成。

sentences.en: They emit no machine code unless instantiated, so you don't pay for them in build time or binary size if you don't use them.
sentences.zh: 除非实例化，否则它们不会发出机器代码，因此如果您不使用它们，则无需为构建时间或二进制大小付费。

sentences.en: The compiler only needs to type-check and borrow-check them, so the build time is almost entirely frontend-bottlenecked.
sentences.zh: 编译器只需要对它们进行类型检查和借用检查，因此构建时间几乎完全是前端瓶颈。

sentences.en: On nightly Rust, using RUSTFLAGS=-Zthreads=8 to enable the parallel frontend halves the compilation time, so we have further improvements to look forward to once the parallel frontend is enabled in the stable toolchain.
sentences.zh: 在 nightly Rust 上，使用 RUSTFLAGS=-Zthreads=8 启用并行前端可将编译时间减半，因此一旦在稳定工具链中启用并行前端，我们就有进一步的改进值得期待。

blocks.html_en: API cleanups prior to 1.0

sentences.en: API cleanups prior to 1.0
sentences.zh: 1.0 之前的 API 清理

blocks.html_en: This release saw the type-specific reinterpret_* methods removed. These methods only existed for a handful of types, and each pair of types would need a separate method, which is impractical. So these were simply dropped in favor of the generic bitcast method. The load_interleaved_128 operation was renamed to load_four_interleaved, to make the intent more clear.

sentences.en: This release saw the type-specific reinterpret_* methods removed.
sentences.zh: 此版本删除了特定于类型的reinterpret_* 方法。

sentences.en: These methods only existed for a handful of types, and each pair of types would need a separate method, which is impractical.
sentences.zh: 这些方法仅适用于少数类型，并且每对类型都需要一个单独的方法，这是不切实际的。

sentences.en: So these were simply dropped in favor of the generic bitcast method.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些都被简单地放弃，转而采用通用位播方法。

sentences.en: The load_interleaved_128 operation was renamed to load_four_interleaved, to make the intent more clear.
sentences.zh: load_interleaved_128 操作已重命名为 load_four_interleaved，以使意图更加清晰。

blocks.html_en: These are fairly minor API cleanups, and the API has been stable for nearly a year. Barring the recent changes to generics, the API has been proven in real-world projects, with over a dozen direct dependents on crates.io, and over a thousand github repositories using it directly or indirectly.

sentences.en: These are fairly minor API cleanups, and the API has been stable for nearly a year.
sentences.zh: 这些都是相当小的 API 清理，并且 API 已经稳定了近一年。

sentences.en: Barring the recent changes to generics, the API has been proven in real-world projects, with over a dozen direct dependents on crates.io, and over a thousand github repositories using it directly or indirectly.
sentences.zh: 除非最近对泛型进行了更改，否则该 API 已经在现实世界的项目中得到了验证，有十几个直接依赖于 crates.io 的项目，以及超过一千个 github 存储库直接或间接使用它。

blocks.html_en: We are confident in the design of the crate, and it's time to make it official. If no concerns about the API are raised, we are going to ship v1.0 of Fearless SIMD in early September.

sentences.en: We are confident in the design of the crate, and it's time to make it official.
sentences.zh: 我们对箱子的设计充满信心，是时候将其正式化了。

sentences.en: If no concerns about the API are raised, we are going to ship v1.0 of Fearless SIMD in early September.
sentences.zh: 如果没有出现对 API 的担忧，我们将于 9 月初发布 Fearless SIMD v1.0。

blocks.html_en: There are no breaking changes planned for v1.0. We could publish it today, but we chose to postpone it to allow some time for feedback from the community before finalizing the API.

sentences.en: There are no breaking changes planned for v1.0.

sentences.en: We could publish it today, but we chose to postpone it to allow some time for feedback from the community before finalizing the API.
sentences.zh: 我们今天可以发布它，但我们选择推迟它，以便在最终确定 API 之前留出一些时间来收集社区的反馈。

content_html_zh:
斯纳采尔，2026 年 8 月 12 日

fearless_simd 消除了 SIMD 中的 unsafe。

无论您追求什么级别的抽象，无论是自动矢量化和多版本化、可移植 SIMD，还是安全访问原始内在函数等等，fearless_simd 都能满足您的需求！

它具有零依赖性、短构建时间、安全的公共 API 以及很少的底层不安全因素 - 比替代方案少几个数量级！

v0.7 中的主要新增内容包括对 64 位整数的支持、替换 x86 上标量回退的显式 SSE2 级别、改进的对泛型编程的支持以及更多实现的 SIMD 操作。

如果没有引起有关 API 的担忧，这也是 Fearless SIMD v1.0 之前的最后一个主要版本。

64 位整数

现在，fearless_simd 的整个 API 界面也针对 u64 和 i64 向量类型公开。

由于硬件支持不稳定，早期版本不支持 64 位整数向量。 例如，AVX2 缺乏对 64 位整数上的许多操作的硬件支持，因此需要使用可用的 SIMD 指令来模拟这些操作才能获得不错的性能。

跟踪哪些内在函数是哪个指令集的一部分也具有挑战性，如果出错将导致内存安全违规。 然而，在 v0.5 中，我们让编译器为我们跟踪它，这从 fearless_simd 中删除了绝大多数不安全的块，并使实现具有不均匀硬件支持的操作变得更加容易。

以前的版本已支持所有其他整数向量类型（i8、u8、i16、u16、i32、u32）和 f32/f64，因此 64 位整数是完整类型覆盖的最后一个缺失部分。 一旦该类型在标准库中稳定下来，我们将研究支持 f16。

更多操作

  • swizzle_dyn 现在已针对所有宽度实现，以允许任意字节洗牌。 我还向 std::simd 贡献了此操作的性能改进。 与 std::simd 不同，Fearless SIMD 支持对越界索引进行清零，并在您确定所有索引都在界限内时返回实现定义的（但内存安全）结果，这比在某些平台上清零要便宜。
  • 所有类型现在都可以加宽/缩小；例如您可以在 SIMD 代码中将 u8 向量转换为 u16，或将 u16 向量转换为 u8。 您可以选择缩小转换是换行（如 as 运算符）还是饱和，或者执行平台必须提供的最便宜的操作（如果您确定值适合较窄的类型，则很有用）。
  • 添加了便利函数shift_elements_left、shift_elements_right、rotate_elements_left和rotate_elements_right，以更好地与std::simd API兼容。 它们已经可以通过幻灯片来实现，但这使得意图更加清晰。

改进的通用编程

对泛型编程（编写向量类型上的泛型函数）的支持已得到显着改进。 以下是一些亮点：

  • SimdBase 特征现在对整数和浮点向量进行抽象，并实现整数和浮点上可用的所有方法。
  • 对字节特征的改进允许 SIMD 向量之间的通用位广播（安全转换）。
  • SIMD 类型上的每一个操作现在都可以通过特征来实现。 没有仅针对具体类型实现的剩余操作。
  • SimdBase::Element 和 SimdBase::Array 等关联类型现在对许多通用边界进行编码，以允许对其进行通用操作。

有关详细信息，请参阅完整的变更日志。 总而言之，通用 SIMD 编程现在更加令人愉快，并且允许通用地表达更多算法。

这些改进也有利于使用宏抽象 SIMD 向量类型的用户，例如编写： $type::from_slice 而不是 T::from_slice。 他们不再需要额外的包（例如粘贴）将类型注入到函数名称中，因为所有操作现在都可以在类型本身上使用。

显式 SSE2 支持

如今，不带 SSE4.2 的 x86 系统非常罕见。 然而，由于 SSE2 是 x86_64 和 i686 Rust 目标中基线指令集的一部分，因此可以假设 SSE2 的存在，而无需任何运行时调度或多版本控制。 某些板条箱只需要非常有限的向量指令集，并且不会从以后的扩展中受益，因此放弃运行时调度可以简化代码并减少二进制大小。

为了更好地服务此用例，Fearless SIMD 现在具有显式 Sse2 级别，其操作以 SIMD 内在函数表示，而不是在 SSE4.2 不可用时依赖回退级别的自动向量化。 当用户选择在运行时不选择最佳 SIMD 实现时，这可以提高 x86 上的性能。

SSE2 在第 2 层 i586 目标上仍然是运行时检测级别，并且可以使用常用的多版本控制来禁用。

构建时间改进

尽管添加了 64 位整数向量、更多支持的操作以及全新的 SSE2 SIMD 级别，但用作依赖项时，fearless_simd 的编译时间仍与 v0.6 相同：x86 从头开始​​ 2 秒，Aarch64 从头开始​​ 1 秒。 这是在我的 Zen 4 桌面 CPU 上通过 Cargo Clean && Cargo build --release --timings 在空箱中根据 fearless_simd 进行测量的。

尽管添加了一些内容，但要保持编译时间不变，需要进行构建分析和优化工作，否则，我的计算机上的 x86 构建时间将增加到 3.4 秒。 对于从头开始的版本构建来说，这仍然不是那么多，并且对于具有其他依赖链（编译时间超过 3.4 秒）的包来说，它是完全不可见的。 但我相信，保持较短的构建时间对于 Fearless SIMD 成为基础 SIMD 抽象非常重要。 这也是fearless_simd 本身没有任何依赖项的一个重要原因。

fearless_simd API 的绝大多数都是由通用函数组成。 除非实例化，否则它们不会发出机器代码，因此如果您不使用它们，则无需为构建时间或二进制大小付费。 编译器只需要对它们进行类型检查和借用检查，因此构建时间几乎完全是前端瓶颈。 在 nightly Rust 上，使用 RUSTFLAGS=-Zthreads=8 启用并行前端可将编译时间减半，因此一旦在稳定工具链中启用并行前端，我们就有进一步的改进值得期待。

1.0 之前的 API 清理

此版本删除了特定于类型的reinterpret_* 方法。 这些方法仅适用于少数类型，并且每对类型都需要一个单独的方法，这是不切实际的。 因此，这些都被简单地放弃，转而采用通用位播方法。 load_interleaved_128 操作已重命名为 load_four_interleaved，以使意图更加清晰。

这些都是相当小的 API 清理，并且 API 已经稳定了近一年。 除非最近对泛型进行了更改，否则该 API 已经在现实世界的项目中得到了验证，有十几个直接依赖于 crates.io 的项目，以及超过一千个 github 存储库直接或间接使用它。

我们对箱子的设计充满信心，是时候将其正式化了。 如果没有出现对 API 的担忧，我们将于 9 月初发布 Fearless SIMD v1.0。

v1.0 没有计划进行重大更改。 我们今天可以发布它，但我们选择推迟它，以便在最终确定 API 之前留出一些时间来收集社区的反馈。

我们希望收到您的来信！

我们相信，fearless_simd 可以成为 Rust 生态系统的基础 SIMD 包，无论您想要自动矢量化、可移植 SIMD、安全访问内在函数还是以上所有。 这个目标现在已经触手可及。

现在我们比以往任何时候都更希望收到您的来信！ 是否有任何 API 不方便或缺失？ 还是一切都进展顺利？ 无论哪种方式，请告诉我们！

您可以在 Github 存储库上提出问题，或者在 Zulip 上与我们交谈。
